description: The timeline's computed `verified` (plan task pod-18, docs/PROOF-RECEIPTS.md) in lib/studio-workflow.mjs: a passing check fresh on the latest tree, the tree after a call and a call without trees, a check that changed the files or ran beside another call, a check that is not scanned, a call that threw, a timeline of an older version; judged by tests/verify-studio-core.mjs.

mutations.name: SW-sticky
mutations.what: any pass verifies, fresh or not

patches.old: if (seen.has(FRESHNESS.fresh)) return { verified: true, freshness: FRESHNESS.fresh };
patches.new: if (passes.length) return { verified: true, freshness: FRESHNESS.fresh };

mutations.name: SW-none
mutations.what: a timeline without a check is of unknown freshness

mutations.name: SW-stale-over-unknown
mutations.what: stale is said when a pass is of unknown tree

mutations.name: SW-proof-ignored
mutations.what: a call's trees do not move the tree

mutations.name: SW-unscanned-unknown
mutations.what: a call that cannot change files makes the tree unknown

mutations.name: SW-no-trees-keeps
mutations.what: a call that may change files and has no trees leaves the tree known

mutations.name: SW-changed-pass
mutations.what: a check that changed the files it checked is a pass

mutations.name: SW-overlapped-pass
mutations.what: a check beside another call is a pass of its tree

mutations.name: SW-unscanned-check-unbound
mutations.what: a check that is not scanned is not bound to the latest tree

mutations.name: SW-error-pass
mutations.what: a call in error counts as a pass

mutations.name: SW-notetree-noop
mutations.what: a call that threw leaves the tree
